notes: Created by the baseline audit of cli-commands/v1 as the destination of its post-freeze bridge protocol, and restructured to own socket framing, peer authentication, caller authorisation, error ordering, evidence commission, reconcile-tier-c and operator-uid trust. A user-scope install cannot admit an operator identity under this version's ownership rules while its text describes one, a defect in the specification rather than a requirement either implementation can meet.
